**ACCESSIBILITY TEST RESULTS & REMEDIATION SUMMARY**

**Test Strategy:** Node.js + Playwright + axe-core (Strategy 3 from WCAG testing guidelines)

**Initial Test Results:**
- 1 best-practice violation: `landmark-unique`
- Issue: Redundant region landmark at `.products-grid` nested within `<section id="featured">`

**Remediation Applied:**
- Removed `role="region" aria-label="Featured products"` from `.products-grid` div

**Final Test Results:**
- ✅ **PASS** - Zero WCAG 2.2 violations
- ✅ **PASS** - Zero best-practice violations

**Accessibility Features Verified:**
✓ Skip-to-main-content link
✓ Semantic HTML5 structure (header, nav, main, section, article, footer)
✓ Proper heading hierarchy (single h1, no skipped levels)
✓ ARIA landmarks and labels on all sections
✓ Descriptive alt text on all images
✓ Accessible names for interactive elements
✓ Form labels properly associated
✓ Keyboard navigation support with visible focus
✓ Mobile menu with aria-expanded state management
✓ Screen reader announcements via aria-live
✓ Forced-colors and reduced-motion support in CSS
✓ Responsive reflow at 320px+ viewports

**Deliverables:**
- `index.html` - Corrected, fully accessible ecommerce homepage
- `styles.css` - Modern, responsive design with accessibility support
- `script.js` - Interactive features with ARIA management
